name: SysMon
author: wartafak
description: Top-bar CPU/GPU/memory usage with temps (GPU hides when absent), hover tooltip with 10-minute averages, click-to-toggle popup (right-click refresh) with summary rings, history graphs and theme-aware colors, plus a sortable top-25 process table with live count, absolute+percent memory, click-to-copy PIDs and per-row TERM/KILL

barWidget.description: Top-bar CPU/GPU/memory with temps, popup with rings, averages, history graphs and sortable process table with TERM/KILL
